name: David M. Gonzalez
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Austin, Texas
side_practice_areas: Criminal Defense, DUI-DWI, White Collar Crimes
about: David M. Gonzalez is an attorney who represents clients in the Austin, Texas area. David Gonzalez is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Gonzalez chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Stanford Law School and graduated in 1999. David Gonzalez passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1999.

He represents clients with Criminal Defense issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Criminal Defense: DUI / DWI, Criminal Defense: White Collar, Civil Litigation: Defense, Civil Rights and Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Gonzalez has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
